description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kendaliyaddepaluwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510811  (24/1099)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and declarations of title determination for specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and encumbrances, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
